decisions.reason: As a charting plugin tightly linked to the firm's web-GIS platform knowledge, it still fits the existing capability base well, though limited recent visibility raises a modest risk of consolidation or bundling.

The hierarchical search plugin remains close to the firm's established geospatial application know-how and can be maintained through customer-specific learning, but its more niche use case makes withdrawal somewhat more plausible than for broader components.

The mobile layer-control component addresses a real usability need and builds on the firm's GIS UX expertise, yet fast-changing mobile frameworks and the absence of recent prominence increase the chance that it could be retired or absorbed into newer solutions.

Mobile field data capture is a strong adjacent application for an integrated geospatial provider with in-house R&D, so the firm is likely to keep it, although its comparatively higher support and development demands create some withdrawal risk.

This search extension is closely related to the firm's installed web-map knowledge and benefits from incremental improvement via projects and feedback, but overlapping functionality and portfolio rationalization keep the exit probability meaningful.
